text: CFPB Complaint No. XXXX Incomplete Investigation and Request for Address Correction I am writing to address the recent communication from Experian regarding the completion of an investigation tied to my CFPB complaint ( No. XXXX ). The investigation is not complete, as there remains an unresolved issue regarding the address listed on my credit report. As I have previously detailed, the address associated with the following identifiers : Address : XXXX XXXX XXXX, XXXX, PA XXXX Address ID : XXXX Geographical Code : XXXX is incorrect, unmailable, non-deliverable, and therefore inaccurate. This continued inaccuracy is a direct violation of the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ), specifically under section 1681. Despite your claim of a completed investigation, this address still appears on my credit report. To rectify this situation and ensure compliance with the FCRA, I am once again providing a recent utility bill and my state-issued identification as proof of my correct address. I am formally requesting the immediate deletion and update of the inaccurate address information from my credit profile. The persistence of this inaccurate information can have detrimental effects on my credit standing and overall financial health. Please expediently process this request and provide written confirmation once the erroneous address has been removed and my credit information has been correctly updated. I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter and expect a response within the statutory timeframe. Thank you for your cooperation. Sincerely,
